newsitem.title: USA: Nacco sees mine offering 1.8 mln tons in '97.
newsitem.headline: Nacco sees mine offering 1.8 mln tons in '97.

text.p: Nacco Industries Inc said Friday it expects its San Miguel Lignite coal mine in Texas to deliver about 1.8 million tons of lignite in 1997.

Thereafter, the mine is expected to produce about 3 million tons annually through 2007, it said. In addition, the company said it expects overall customer lignite requirements at its other operating mines to remain firm over the next six months.

Meanwhile, Nacco said it anticipates that its lift-truck industry bookings in the Americas will continue to be strong. The company said it is basing that projection on second-quarter factory bookings, which were at the highest levels since the first quarter of 1995.

At its Hamilton Beach/Proctor-Silex unit, the new Saltillo facility in Mexico is expected to continue to ramp up production during 1997. As of June 30, the facility was manufacturing selected lines of blenders and toasters.
